task_summary: Implement interleave in solution.py, add unittest regression coverage in public tests, and document design decisions plus the verification command in HANDOFF.md.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Alternate left then right items, then append the longer input's remainder in order; empty inputs are valid.
Use unittest and verify with python -m unittest discover -v.
test_solution.py must contain at least 3 passing unittest test methods that exercise the public API.

success_criteria.description: solution.py contains a type-hinted public interleave implementation.
test_solution.py includes at least three unittest test methods.

check.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); assert sum(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith("test") for c in tree.body if isinstance(c, ast.ClassDef) and any(isinstance(b, ast.Name) and b.id == "TestCase" for b in c.bases) for n in c.body) >= 3'

success_criteria.description: The unittest discovery command succeeds, covering the regression tests.
HANDOFF.md records design decisions and the verification command.

check.pattern: (?is)(design decisions|design decision).*(python -m unittest discover -v)|(python -m unittest discover -v).*(design decisions|design decision)

assumptions: The requested files may not exist yet and may be created.
The relative paths solution.py, test_solution.py, and HANDOFF.md are interpreted as workspace-root paths.
The interleave public API accepts two iterable inputs and returns a newly constructed interleaved collection; the exact input and output collection types are unspecified.
The three required unittest methods are assumed to be methods on a unittest.TestCase subclass in test_solution.py.
